title: The UK CMA launches an investigation into Adobe, saying early membership cancellation fees for certain products might be in breach of consumer protection laws (Mauro Orru/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Mauro Orru / Wall Street Journal: The UK CMA launches an investigation into Adobe, saying early membership cancellation fees for certain products might be in breach of consumer protection laws — The probe will assess Adobe terms and if customers get clear, timely information — U.K. antitrust officials launched …
contentText:
Mauro Orru / Wall Street Journal :

The UK CMA launches an investigation into Adobe, saying early membership cancellation fees for certain products might be in breach of consumer protection laws   —  The probe will assess Adobe terms and if customers get clear, timely information  —  U.K. antitrust officials launched …
